COLOR MATCH ARENA — PRISM

Yeu cau: JDK 24. Dat JAVA_HOME tro toi thu muc JDK neu may dang dung Java 8.
Mo Chay_Game.bat. Thu muc nay da du assets va am thanh trong file JAR.
Khong can MySQL, Python hay source code tren may chi choi client.

Hai laptop chung Wi-Fi:
1. May chu chay Chay_Server.bat o thu muc repo, voi MySQL da cau hinh.
2. May chu dung ipconfig de lay dia chi IPv4 Wi-Fi.
3. Client tren may chu: Host 127.0.0.1, Cong 5000.
4. Client tren may khac: Host la IPv4 cua may chu, Cong 5000.
5. Dang nhap hai tai khoan khac nhau, vao sanh va thach dau.
6. Cho phep Java qua Firewall tren mang Private neu can.

Server va tat ca client phai dung cung ban Prism nay.
Ban JAR cu o dist/ goc khong tuong thich voi giao thuc BoardState moi.

Cai dat: nut Cai dat trong login/sanh/tran de chinh nhac, hieu ung,
tat am thanh hoac giam chuyen dong. Lua chon duoc luu tren tung may.

Ban co: di chuot de xem quan thu; phim mui ten va Enter/Space de dat quan.
Noi tu 3 quan ngang/doc/cheo se tao tia, tia dung truoc quan doi thu.
Diem la so o lanh tho, khong phai so quan dang tren ban.
